name: Tsuki no Sabaki
source: A parody game using the characters from [url=/v7]Tsukihime[/url] to tell a courtroom drama story in the style of [url=/v711]Gyakuten Saiban[/url]. Most of the background is used only loosely, and no supernatural elements are involved at all.
